title: Output-Only Identification and Spectral Monitoring of Coupled Feedback Networks with Known Time-Varying Actuation
abstract: arXiv:2608.25844v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coupled feedback networks are often monitored channel by channel even though cross-channel paths alter both stability margins and transmitted disturbances. We study identification of a structured feedback matrix L_t = Phi diag(gamma_t) in an output-only setting: no commanded, probing, or reference input exists -- only temporally separated outputs and the scheduling gains gamma_t are observed, while the coupling response Phi and the clearing-window inputs are not. Identification rests jointly on the persistent excitation of the observed pre-window output and on two structural features separating coupling from confounds: the known time variation of the gains, which modulates the closed-loop response in a predictable pattern, and a partial-reversal moment by which a known fraction of transient displacement is corrected in a subsequent window. We give a hierarchy of results: exact local identification of the coupling under a Jacobian rank

translated_title: 仅输出识别与已知时变驱动的耦合反馈网络频谱监测
translated_abstract: 耦合反馈网络通常按通道逐一监测，尽管跨通道路径会改变稳定裕度和传递扰动。我们研究了在仅输出设置下对结构化反馈矩阵L_t = Phi diag(gamma_t)的识别问题：不存在指令、探测或参考输入——仅观察到时间分离的输出和调度增益gamma_t，而耦合响应Phi和清除窗口输入未知。识别过程依赖于观测窗口前输出的持续激励以及两个将耦合与混淆因素分离的结构特征：增益的已知时变特性（以可预测模式调制闭环响应）和部分反转矩（在后续窗口中修正已知比例的瞬态位移）。我们给出了一系列结果：在雅可比秩条件下的精确局部耦合识别。
tldr: 本文提出了一种仅基于输出数据、利用已知时变增益和部分反转矩结构，在无探针输入条件下精确识别耦合反馈网络的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method for exact identification of coupled feedback networks using only output data, leveraging known time-varying gains and partial-reversal moments without probing inputs.
